stage: Stage 8: Choose the supplier on the row
note: 1.8 moves no figure. /cart gains seven fields on every line and nothing else: supplierRuledNone on the line (Allied ruled the item has no supplier), and six in its rationale (leadTimeDaysUsed and leadTimeUsedFor: the lead time the suggestion was built on and whose, the item's effective supplier's; leadTimeUsedSource: where that lead came from, item / supplier / measured, or null with none; leadStockBasis: window, manual or lead; minWindowMonths and minLeadTimeDays: the window and lead a window minimum was set from). rationale.leadTimeDays (the line's own supplier's) is unchanged, for tabs from before 1.8. Lines, quantities, states, supplier groups, totals, decisions, pick conflicts, removed items and cart.csv must be unchanged; anything else changing is a failure. The write changes (select/split validation, Undo keeping a typed qty) change no GET response on the same rows.
reviewed: Generated by hand from two in-process captures (stage-check capture through the real router, GET only) on the 26 Aug local copy (allied_dev), the 1.7 tree (e2de9dd) then this tree, on the same data with no cart decisions: 932 differences, all allowed: release.version 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0, and 931 additions (133 lines x 7 fields); re-captured on the final tree after review. cart.csv, items.csv, items.json, every watched item page, kit pages, overview, suppliers and divergence identical. On every line leadTimeDaysUsed and leadTimeUsedFor equal the item's leadTimeDays and supplierName in items.json, supplierRuledNone equals the item's (true on the 46 'No known supplier' lines: every one is ruled on the copy), leadTimeUsedSource is 'measured' on 87 and null on the 46 with no supplier (the copy has no item leads; on prod N24S16M, WR16503G, WR16301.5S16 and TB12125S16 read 'item'), and leadStockBasis is 'lead' on all 133 (the copy has no applied minimums; all 87 applied on prod at 13 Oct are window-based, so prod reads 'window' on those). The entries are record wildcards that name only the new fields, so an existing figure moving on any line still fails.

allow.why: every deploy reports its own version (1.7.0 -> 1.8.0) and commit
1.8 adds the item's 'ruled no supplier' flag to each line, so By item can say No supplier (ruled)
1.8 adds the lead time the suggestion was built on (the item's effective supplier's), so Why this quantity names it
1.8 adds whose lead time that is (the effective supplier's name)
1.8 adds where that lead time came from (item / supplier / measured, the item's leadTimeSource), so a lead set on the item is not credited to the supplier
1.8 adds what set the lead-time stock: window minimum, manual minimum, or the live lead time
1.8 adds the window a window minimum was set over (null otherwise)
1.8 adds the lead time a window minimum was set from (null otherwise)
